column3: NKJV inserts speaker headings such as “THE SHULAMITE,” which are not in the Hebrew; “your loves” is rendered “your love.”
Close to the Hebrew; “young women” is rendered “the virgins.”
NKJV divides the verse among speakers with inserted headings; “uprightly they love you” is rendered “Rightly do they love you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “black” is rendered “dark,” and “and” “but.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the sun has looked on me” is rendered “the sun has tanned me.”
NKJV adds the heading “(TO HER BELOVED)”; “whom my soul loves” is rendered “you whom I love,” and NKJV supplies “your flock.”
NKJV adds the heading “THE BELOVED”; “dwelling places” is rendered “tents.”
Close to the Hebrew; רַעְיָתִי (“my companion”) is rendered “my love.”
Close to the Hebrew; “strings of beads” is rendered “chains of gold.”
NKJV adds a heading for the daughters of Jerusalem; “beads of silver” is rendered “studs of silver.”
NKJV adds the heading “THE SHULAMITE”; “nard” is rendered “spikenard.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it lodges” is rendered “That lies all night.”
NKJV adds the heading “THE BELOVED”; “your eyes are doves” is rendered “You have dove’s eyes.”
NKJV adds the heading “THE SHULAMITE”; “luxuriant” is rendered “green.”
Close to the Hebrew; “cypress” is rendered “fir.”
